City of Central Falls 
Special City Council Meeting  
1280 High Street 
Central Falls, RI 02863 
Friday October 30, 2026 
5:30 p.m. 
 
 
Agenda 
Posted: 10/28/2026 
Time: 3:00 pm     
 
I. Roll Call 
Council President Pro Tempore Alberto Rivas called the meeting to order at 5:30 p.m. City Clerk Alberto de 
Burgo conducted the roll call. Present were Councilpersons Kazarian, Peguero, Rosado-Martinez, Solano, and 
Rivas Lugo. Absent were Council President Ferri and Councilperson Baena. 
 
II. Pledge of Allegiance 
Council President Pro Temp Rivas Lugo led the Council in the pledge of Allegiance 
 
III. Public Comment 
None 
 
IV. Executive Communications 
a. Consideration of appointment by Mayor Maria Rivera of Andrew Mello of Providence, to 
the Wyatt Detention Facility Board with a term set to expire November 1, 2031 
The Council may vote on this item 
Chief of Staff to Mayor Maria Rivera, Lorraine Quintero, addressed the Council and introduced the 
appointee, Andrew Mello, Esquire. Ms. Quintero provided an overview of Mr. Mello’s professional 
background. Mr. Mello then addressed the Council, explaining his interest in becoming involved with the City 
and serving on the Wyatt Detention Center Board. He also responded to questions from Council members 
regarding his interest in the appointment. 
 
A motion to approve the appointment of Andrew Mello to the Wyatt Detention Center Board was made by 
Councilperson Rosado-Martinez and seconded by Councilperson Solano. The motion passed unanimously, 
5–0. 
 
V. Adjournment 
A motion to adjourn was made by Councilperson Kazarian and seconded by Councilperson Peguero. The 
motion passed, and the meeting adjourned at 5:36 p.m.
